intro: Thunderbrew is a straightforward brewing errand undertaken for the wandering dwarf Grimbooze Thunderbrew in Westfall. To prevent his latest batch from tasting more like stew than rich dwarven lager, Grimbooze requires fresh hops gathered from the surrounding countryside. Adventurers who assist him are rewarded with a fresh, frothy keg of his potent craft.
